Three Ingredient Party Shrimp
By: Lacy DeVeney
Published: Tuesday, October 11, 2011 - 8:58am

Ingredients




2 lbs raw shrimp (medium sized)
40 oz of cheap beer (Miller Genuine Draft is excellent)
2.62 oz Old Bay Seasoning

Preparation

1 Take shrimp, dump in BIG POT. Stay with me here folks. This is where it gets tricky. Take CHEAP BEER and dump into BIG POT. Are you still with me? Now take your 2.62 oz of Old Bay and dump the whole thing, (Yes, the WHOLE thing!), into the BIG POT. STIR. Then turn heat on high and bring to boil, stirring occasionally. 2 When your shrimp are pinkish-orangey looking (cooked through), remove them from liquid. Place in large bowl, pour remaining liquid into dipping bowls and serve.

About

Delicious and simple shrimp appetizer made from just three ingredients. This dish is perfect for a party or a meal in a hurry. Your guests will be impressed.
